title: Outside arrangers, 'Whispering Grass' and 'Gabriel Heater'
summary: He used a few outside arrangers and names an RCA-assembled tune.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: So primarily, your arranging was done by Sammy Lowe, Avery Parrish,
Yeah. And William Leroy Kirkland, guitar. He was in there.
Then I got a couple, I had a couple of arrangers on the out- side too that when I wanted something special. I'm trying to think of the name.

You know, I introduced "Whispering Green Grass". You know the tune the Ink Spots made years later? I introduced that but Jimmy Mitchelle sang it. The fellow used to play banjo or guitar with Fletcher Henderson. He made that. I had him on the side. He made that for me.

Then, I had something by the name of "20th Century Gabriel"? No. "Gabriel Heater". I had an original tune by the name of "Gabriel Heater". Now, that's one of the arrangements that I do that was from the head of the Music Department at RCA Victor. He put that together. We had a contest on that on how we would name it.
